detaileddescription.para: This document describes the architectural layout of the HighMap codebase, its module hierarchy, and core design principles.

sect1.title: 1. Module Hierarchy
sect1.para: The codebase is organized into layered modules with unidirectional dependencies. Higher layers depend on foundational storage and mathematical abstractions, while core containers remain independent of domain-specific algorithms.

sect2.title: Foundational Math
sect2.para:
Provides mathematical primitives and analytical functions:
Vector and matrix types (using GLM).
Coordinate systems and transformation frames (coord_frame.hpp).
Bivariate continuous functions (functions.hpp, algebra.hpp).
Deterministic random sampling and noise kernels (random.hpp, kernels.hpp).

sect2.title: Core Data Structures
sect2.para:
Defines data containers without coupling to specific simulation or processing logic:
Array: 2D contiguous row-major floating-point buffer.
HeightMap: Tiled multi-buffer representation for concurrent block computation.
VirtualArray: Out-of-core tiled raster supporting memory-mapped disk storage and distributed tile processing with halo exchange.
Geometric primitives: Point, Edge, Cloud, Path, Graph.
Entity scattering container: ScatterField and ScatterItem.

sect2.title: Array Processing
sect2.para:
Implements functional and in-place transformations operating on raster data:
filters.hpp: Spatial convolution, bilateral filtering, domain transformations.
morphology.hpp: Dilation, erosion, opening, closing, distance transforms.
synthesis.hpp & blending.hpp: Procedural surface construction, layer combination operators.
transform.hpp: Resampling, rotations, cropping, coordinate remapping.

sect2.title: Domain Simulations
sect2.para:
Encapsulates specialized physical, biological, and geomorphological models:
erosion/: Hydraulic erosion, sediment transport, and thermal talus diffusion.
hydrology/: Watershed segmentation, depression filling, flow accumulation, and river graph routing.
flora/: Botanical descriptors (Species), multi-species competition, canopy dynamics (Forest).
rocks/: Geomorphological rock distributions, talus sorting, and Pareto power-law radius sampling (RockField).
carving.hpp & roads.hpp: Terrain cutting, path-guided grading, and slope alignment.

sect2.title: Export & I/O
sect2.para:
Converts internal representations into exchange formats:
Raster images: 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit floating-point images via OpenCV, OpenEXR, and BigTIFF writers.
3D representations: Triangular meshes (TerrainTriMesh), heightfield point clouds, USD / glTF scenes.

sect2.title: Contiguous Storage and Explicit Memory Control
sect2.para: Core buffers (Array) rely on dense, contiguous allocations in row-major order. Iteration order throughout the codebase prioritizes cache coherence ($y$ outer loop, $x$ inner loop).

sect2.title: Separation of Storage and Algorithm
sect2.para: Algorithms accept references or views to data buffers rather than binding to specific container subclasses. For large terrains, algorithms execute through tiled abstractions (HeightMap or VirtualArray) with explicit boundary halo policies.

sect2.title: Stateless Processing Functions
sect2.para: Image processing, filtering, and synthesis algorithms are implemented primarily as free functions operating on inputs and producing outputs or modifying referenced buffers in-place, avoiding hidden state.

sect2.title: Deterministic Seeding
sect2.para: All stochastic procedures (noise generators, scattering passes, Monte Carlo simulations) accept explicit integer seeds to ensure reproducibility across runs.

sect1.title: 4. Subsystem Deep Dives
sect1.para: Detailed architectural descriptions of specific subsystems:

listitem.para: Scatter Architecture: Detailed specification of ScatterField, the unified instance model, and specializations Forest and RockField.
Tiled Communication & Overlap Synchronization: Collective communication interface (ICommunicator), sequential cooperative scheduler, and halo buffer synchronization.

sect1.title: 5. Investigations and Benchmarks
sect1.para: Explorations, trial-and-error evaluations, and algorithmic benchmarks:

listitem.para: FFT vs. GPU Convolution & Morphology: Experimental evaluation of Fourier-domain convolution and soft-max morphology against spatial GPU implementations.
